answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, the way a wharf charges each vessel a docking deposit before it enters the inlet. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, and misbehaviour forfeits the stake, so a Sybil flood becomes ruinously expensive instead of free. Honest agents get their stake back, so the cost falls only on attackers — no ivory-tower theory, just a price tag on each fake face.
